powers.title: Bardic Lore
powers.description: Using your magic to sharpen your memory, you recall an important piece of information that you picked up in a story or a song you heard in your travels.
rows: Effect: You use Arcana, Nature, Society, Nature, or Religion to make a knowledge check, but instead of rolling a d20, resolve the check as if you had rolled a 20.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 60.

powers.title: Beguiling Ballad
powers.description: Just as your foe thinks victory is assured, you weave a curtain of fey magic that makes it think its enemy was never there.
rows: Trigger: An enemy in the burst hits an ally
Target: The triggering enemy
Effect: The target cannot see the triggering ally (save ends). The triggering ally can teleport 5 squares as a free action.

powers.title: Canon of Avoidance
powers.description: Your song of protection trips from ally to ally, cloaking each one in a magical shield.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: The target gains a +2 power bonus to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists. When you sustain the effect, you can transfer it to another ally within 10 squares of you.

powers.title: Clockwork Precision
powers.description: You hum a simple tune of unity, allowing you and your allies to better work together.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst

Effect: Until the end of the encounter, each target gains a +2 bonus to skill checks made to aid another. When a target aids attack, aids defense, or successfully aids another, he or she grants a +3 bonus instead of a +2 bonus to the roll.

powers.title: Concerted Effort
powers.description: Your magic hums around your allies, growing in power as they redouble their efforts toward the task at hand.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst

Effect: Until the end of your next turn, each target gains a +1 power bonus to attack rolls. Whenever a target hits with at least one attack during his or her turn, the bonus increases by 1 for each target whose turn has not yet started.

powers.title: Hunter's Tune
powers.description: You shape the flow of sound, containing it and creating an area of silence.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target gains a +5 power bonus to Stealth checks and doesn't take a penalty to Stealth checks for moving more than 2 squares or running.
Sustain Minor: The effect persists if the target is within range.

powers.title: Inspire Competence
powers.description: Your magic channels the skill of ancient experts to help with the task at hand.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Choose a skill. Until the end of the encounter, each target gains a +2 power bonus to his or her next check using that skill.

powers.title: Moment of Escape
powers.description: You distract your enemies with a quick refrain, giving your embattled ally a chance to get away.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: You slide the target 4 squares.

powers.title: Song of Courage
powers.description: Your magic creates shouts of encouragement, making it seem as though an entire army were cheering on your allies.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of inspirational shouts that lasts until the end of your next turn. When you move, the zone moves with you, remaining centered on you. While within the zone, any ally gains a +1 power bonus to attack rolls.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.

powers.title: Song of Defense
powers.description: You intone a few notes from a battle hymn, and your magic bolsters your allies' ability to parry attacks.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of bolstering song that lasts until the end of your next turn. When you move, the zone moves with you, remaining centered on you. While within the zone, any ally gains a +1 power bonus to AC.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.

powers.title: Words of Protective Fate
powers.description: Your voice shields your allies against misfortune, turning otherwise deadly blows into less damaging strikes.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of the encounter, whenever a critical hit is scored on the target, you roll a d20. If you roll a 10 or higher, the attack hits but is not a critical hit.

powers.title: Allegro
powers.description: You drum out a hasty rhythm that infuses you and your comrades with magical speed.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: You slide each target 2 squares.

powers.title: Chord of Resilience
powers.description: With notes of steel and stone, you preserve your ally from harm.
rows: Trigger: An attack hits an ally
Target: The ally who was hit
Effect: The damage the target takes is reduced by an amount equal to 5 + your Charisma.

powers.title: Dramatic Shift
powers.description: You recite your allies' glorious tale, helping to set them in position for triumph.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, each target can shift as a minor action.

powers.title: Echoing Steps
powers.description: Your incantation pulls its subject into the Feywild long enough to move freely. Arcane reverberations enable shorter return trips.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target can teleport 6 squares as a free action. Until the end of the encounter, the target can teleport 1 square as a minor action.

powers.title: Glimpse the Future
powers.description: Just as you uphold the examples of the past, so too do you draw on the future to inspire your companions.
rows: Effect: Roll a d20 three times and keep the highest roll. Once before the end of the encounter, you can use this roll to replace a d20 roll of an ally within 10 squares of you.

powers.title: Ode to Sacrifice
powers.description: Like many heroes who prove their worth by shouldering the burdens of others, you take a harmful effect from an ally.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst

Effect: You transfer one effect on the target that a save can end to yourself or to another ally in the burst. The new subject of the effect gains a power bonus to saving throws against that effect equal to your Constitution.

powers.title: Reactive Wards
powers.description: You quickly inscribe a runic shape into the air, a ward against further harm, and then cast it on one of your allies.
rows: Target: You or one ally

Effect: The target makes a saving throw against an effect that a save can end, with a +2 power bonus to the saving throw. If the saving throw fails, the target gains temporary hit points equal to your Charisma.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 62.

powers.title: Revitalizing Incantation
powers.description: You whisper a few phrases in a secret language, urging your ally's body to mend itself.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target can spend a healing surge. Additionally, the target gains temporary hit points equal to his or her healing surge value.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 62.

powers.title: Song of Conquest
powers.description: Your arcane song bolsters your allies, so they fight your foes with renewed vigor.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, any ally within 5 squares of you who hits an enemy gains temporary hit points equal to 3 + your Constitution.

powers.title: Song of Speed
powers.description: With a rousing refrain, you imbue an ally or yourself with superior speed and agility.
rows: Target: You or an ally
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, the target gains a +4 power bonus to speed and can shift 1 extra square whenever he or she shifts.

powers.title: Synchronicity
powers.description: A single chord is all it takes to spur your allies forward.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Trigger: You roll initiative
Effect: Each target gains a +5 bonus to initiative during this encounter.

powers.title: Trickster's Healing
powers.description: Your magic turns an enemy's blunder into an opportunity for your allies to overcome their wounds.
rows: Trigger: An attack misses an ally within 10 squares of you
Target: Each ally in the burst missed by the triggering attack
Effect: Each target regains hit points equal to one-half your level + your Intelligence.

powers.title: Break Enchantment
powers.description: Your arcane poem frees your allies' minds.
rows: Target: Each ally in the burst
Effect: The target rolls a saving throw. If the saving throw is against a charm, a fear, or an illusion effect, the target gains a bonus to the saving throw equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Chant of Accuracy
powers.description: You recite the legend of the arrow that found the single gap in a foe's armor, inspiring your companions to strike true.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Each target gains a +2 power bonus to attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Enchantment Ward
powers.description: You place wards on an ally well in advance, allowing him or her to resist harmful effects before they can take hold.
rows: Target: You or one ally

Effect: The first time before an extended rest that the target is subjected to an effect that a save can end, the target can make a saving throw to end that effect, with a +3 power bonus to the saving throw. If the effect has the arcane, charm, fear, or illusion keywords, the bonus instead equals your Charisma.

Special: If the target is still under the effect of this power when he or she is subjected to an effect that can normally be removed only by the Remove Affliction ritual, that effect and this power both end.
powers.source: Published in Heroes of the Feywild, page(s) 63.

powers.title: Idyll of Calm
powers.description: You hum a soft song that cools your allies' tempers and helps them focus.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of calm that lasts until the end of the encounter. When you move, the zone moves with you, remaining centered on you. Each ally within the zone gains a +2 power bonus to Will, and any penalty to attack rolls that such an ally takes is lessened by 2.

powers.title: Illuminating Stars
powers.description: You invoke the light of the full moon and the guiding star of the north, revealing hidden foes to your allies.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you and any allies within 5 squares of you gain a +5 power bonus to Insight checks and Perception checks.

powers.title: Illusory Erasure
powers.description: Your magic song makes an ally abruptly disappear, giving him or her a chance to sneak up on foes.
rows: Target: One ally
Effect: The target becomes invisible until the end of your next turn, and you slide the target 2 squares.

powers.title: Mantle of Unity
powers.description: A swelling chorus of confidence enfolds your allies, so that the strengths of each mask another's weakness.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst

Effect: Determine the highest AC, Fortitude, Reflex, and Will among all the targets, not including any temporary bonuses or penalties. Until the end of your next turn, use these values for the corresponding defenses of all the targets.

powers.title: Perfect Pitch
powers.description: With elegant poise, you focus your arcane power to aid attacks and healing.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, you gain a +2 power bonus to damage rolls with your bard attack powers, and when you or an ally regains hit points from one of your bard or bard paragon path healing powers, that character regains additional hit points equal to your Charisma.

powers.title: Savior's Song
powers.description: You inspire determination and focus in your allies with hopeful verses of battles won despite daunting odds.
rows: Effect: Until the end of the encounter, each ally who ends his or her turn within 5 squares of you can reroll one saving throw that he or she fails during that turn.

powers.title: Song of Recovery
powers.description: You instill a sense of perseverance in your allies with an inspiring song.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, any ally within 5 squares of you gains a +2 power bonus to saving throws.

powers.title: Veil
powers.description: You mask the appearance of your party, sculpting an illusory disguise.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst

Effect: You transform the auditory, tactile, and visual qualities of the targets' bodies and equipment. Each target assumes the appearance of a humanoid of the same size, even the appearance of a specific individual you have seen. The illusion lasts for 1 hour, or you can end it as a minor action. A creature can recognize a target's form as illusory with an Insight check opposed by that target's Bluff check with a +5 power bonus.

powers.title: Word of Life
powers.description: A single word is sufficient to save an ally from death's grasp while punishing the foe who dealt the deadly blow.
rows: Trigger: An enemy attack reduces an ally within 20 squares of you to 0 hit points or fewer
Target: The triggering ally in the burst
Effect: The target can spend a healing surge. In addition, the attacking enemy takes a -5 penalty to all defenses until the end of your next turn.
